## Rendering

Dr. Jung walked through rendering Quarto files. Rendering turns the .qmd (code + writing) into the .html that GitHub Pages actually publishes.

- Render in the Positron Terminal: `quarto render filename.qmd`
- Re-render after every edit. Pages shows the .html, not the .qmd, so an old .html means an old live page.
- Images live in the images/ subfolder. If one is missing on the live page, check the file path and name spelling first.
- After rendering: git pull, add, commit, push, then wait 1 to 2 minutes and check the live link.
